name: チョコ遅刻(チョコレート)

works.body:
Hello, I would like to request an artwork for a Snackbox micro with the characters Sandalphon and Lucifer from Granblue Fantasy

Template for the Snackbox micro: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1o6Lm1iX8rGNnl5jOk_htcRS5VbjDTc22?usp=drive_link and focusattack.com

I would like the left to have Sandalphon with a queasy/dizzy expression similar to this:  https://drive.google.com/file/d/1Blb3NHDoYpsZXdUdNQOxLdKJzILmUXxF/view?usp=drive_link (another reference https://drive.google.com/file/d/1mximH-q5MYK8bucZjRtTqw1fqs91nU5i/view?usp=drive_link ) in his cafe outfit here: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1ZB-cmIVetcM7-dMj_w3cXEC49eN4hUAX/view?usp=drive_link

Lucifer is next to Sandalphon, helping (or guiding) him to rest, rubbing his back. Lucifer's outfit or anything extra up to your imagination

The right, if possible, to have a dialogue in Japanese, with Lucifer saying, "I don't think less of you for getting airsick," and Sandalphon saying, "Bleah, I'm sorry." Higher appeal, ok.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1RKI0oIOUaSN__A3prfXhwjaGIyf1fDnF?usp=drive_link
